==English==

===Alternative forms===
* {{alt|en|præparation||archaic}}

===Etymology===
{{root|en|ine-pro|*per-|id=before}}
From {{inh|en|enm|preparacion}}, from {{der|en|frm|preparacion}}, from {{der|en|la|praeparatio|praeparātiō, praeparātiōnem}}. Morphologically {{suffix|en|prepare|ation}}.

===Pronunciation===
* {{IPA|en|/ˌpɹɛpəˈɹeɪʃ(ə)n/|a=RP,GA}}
** {{audio|en|en-us-preparation.ogg|a=California}}
* {{hyph|en|prep|a|ra|tion}}
* {{rhymes|en|eɪʃən|s=4}}

===Noun===
{{en-noun|~}}

# {{lb|en|uncountable}} The act of [[preparing]] or getting [[ready]].
#: {{ux|en|I went over my notes in '''preparation''' for the exam.}}
# {{lb|en|uncountable}} The state of being prepared; [[readiness]].
# {{lb|en|countable}} That which is [[prepare]]d.
## A [[substance]], especially a [[remedy]], that is prepared.
##: {{ux|en|The traditional remedy is a bitter '''preparation''' made from steamed herbs.}}
## {{lb|en|anatomy}} A part of any animal body [[preserve]]d as a [[specimen]].
## {{lb|en|music}} Any of the objects placed between the strings of a [[prepared piano]].
# {{lb|en|Judaism}} The day before the [[Sabbath]] or other Jewish feast-day.
# [[devotional|Devotional]] [[exercise]]s introducing an [[office]].
# {{lb|en|music}} The previous introduction, as an integral part of a [[chord]], of a [[note]] continued into a succeeding [[dissonance]].
